selected.goal: Add regression coverage for stale manifest after fixture mutation to break the cycle of non-regression epochs touching the same core files

Higher priorities clean: no failing tests/crashes (rank 1), no lifecycle correctness issues (rank 2) — all 136 framework tests pass. This is not cosmetic/DX cleanup; it adds determinism regression coverage for manifest staleness after fixture mutation, breaking the pattern of re-touching the same core files without expanding coverage.
non_goals: do not touch run.ts or playbook-loop-seed.test.ts
implementation_steps: Create a regression test that compiles a playbook, copies and edits a fixture TASK.md, re-compiles, and asserts the manifest changed
Run the test to confirm it fails (stale manifest not detected)
Fix run-state-manager.ts so re-compile after fixture mutation produces an updated manifest
Run the regression test to confirm it passes
Run full build to confirm no regressions
